problems.statementHtml: What is the value of \(\dfrac{11!-10!}{9!}?\)
For what value of \(x\) does \[10^{x} \cdot 100^{2x}=1000^{5}?\]
For every dollar Ben spent on bagels, David spent \(25\) cents less. Ben paid \(\$12.50\) more than David. How much did they spend in the bagel store together?
problems.statementZhHtml: Ben 每花一美元买贝果，David 就少花 \(25\) 美分。Ben 比 David 多付 \(\$12.50\)。他们两人在贝果店一共花了多少钱？

problems.statementHtml: The remainder function can be defined for all real numbers \(x\) and \(y\) with \(y \neq 0\) by \[\operatorname{rem}(x,y)=x-y\left\lfloor\frac{x}{y}\right\rfloor,\] where \(\left \lfloor \frac{x}{y} \right \rfloor\) denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to \(\frac{x}{y}.\) What is the value of \(\text{rem} \left(\frac{3}{8}, -\frac{2}{5} \right)?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 对所有实数 \(x\) 和满足 \(y \neq 0\) 的实数 \(y\)，余数函数定义为 \[\operatorname{rem}(x,y)=x-y\left\lfloor\frac{x}{y}\right\rfloor\text{，}\] 其中 \(\left \lfloor \frac{x}{y} \right \rfloor\) 表示小于或等于 \(\frac{x}{y}\) 的最大整数。求 \(\text{rem} \left(\frac{3}{8}, -\frac{2}{5} \right)\) 的值。

problems.statementHtml: A rectangular box has integer side lengths in the ratio \(1:3:4.\) Which of the following could be the volume of the box?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个长方体的整数边长之比为 \(1:3:4\)。下列哪个数可能是这个长方体的体积？

problems.statementHtml: Ximena lists the whole numbers \(1\) through \(30\) once. Emilio copies Ximena’s numbers, replacing each occurrence of the digit \(2\) by the digit \(1.\) Ximena adds her numbers and Emilio adds his numbers. How much larger is Ximena’s sum than Emilio’s?
problems.statementZhHtml: Ximena 把整数 \(1\) 到 \(30\) 各列出一次。Emilio 抄写 Ximena 的数，但把每次出现的数字 \(2\) 都替换成数字 \(1\)。Ximena 把她的数相加，Emilio 把他的数相加。Ximena 的和比 Emilio 的和大多少？

problems.statementHtml: The mean, median, and mode of the \(7\) data values \[60, 100, x, 40, 50, 200, 90\] are all equal to \(x.\) What is the value of \(x?\)

Trickster Rabbit agrees with Foolish Fox to double Fox’s money every time Fox crosses the bridge by Rabbit’s house, as long as Fox pays \(40\) coins in toll to Rabbit after each crossing. The payment is made after the doubling. Fox is excited about his good fortune until he discovers that all his money is gone after crossing the bridge three times. How many coins did Fox have at the beginning?
problems.statementZhHtml: Trickster Rabbit 同意每次 Foolish Fox 经过 Rabbit 家旁边的桥时，都把 Fox 的钱翻倍，但 Fox 每次过桥后必须向 Rabbit 支付 \(40\) 枚硬币的过路费。付款在翻倍之后进行。Fox 起初很高兴，但他发现自己过桥三次后钱全没了。Fox 一开始有多少枚硬币？

problems.statementHtml: A triangular array of \(2016\) coins has \(1\) coin in the first row, \(2\) coins in the second row, \(3\) coins in the third row, and so on up to \(N\) coins in the \(N\)th row. What is the sum of the digits of \(N?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个由 \(2016\) 枚硬币组成的三角形阵列，第一行有 \(1\) 枚硬币，第二行有 \(2\) 枚，第三行有 \(3\) 枚，依此类推，第 \(N\) 行有 \(N\) 枚。求 \(N\) 的各位数字之和。

problems.statementHtml: A rug is made with three different colors as shown. The areas of the three differently colored regions form an arithmetic progression. The inner rectangle is one foot wide, and each of the two shaded regions is \(1\) foot wide on all four sides. What is the length in feet of the inner rectangle?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一块地毯由如图所示的三种不同颜色组成。三种不同颜色区域的面积构成一个等差数列。最内层长方形宽为一英尺，外面的两个区域在四周各宽 \(1\) 英尺。最内层长方形的长度是多少英尺？

problems.statementHtml: What is the area of the shaded region of the given \(8\times5\) rectangle?
problems.statementZhHtml: 给定的 \(8\times5\) 长方形中，阴影区域的面积是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Three distinct integers are selected at random between \(1\) and \(2016,\) inclusive. Which of the following is a correct statement about the probability \(p\) that the product of the three integers is odd?
problems.statementZhHtml: 从 \(1\) 到 \(2016\) 之间随机选取三个不同的整数。下列哪一句正确描述了这三个整数乘积为奇数的概率 \(p\)？

problems.statementHtml:
Five friends sat in a movie theater in a row containing \(5\) seats, numbered \(1\) to \(5\) from left to right. (The directions “left” and “right” are from the point of view of the people as they sit in the seats.)

During the movie Ada went to the lobby to get some popcorn. When she returned, she found that Bea had moved two seats to the right, Ceci had moved one seat to the left, and Dee and Edie had switched seats, leaving an end seat for Ada. In which seat had Ada been sitting before she got up?
problems.statementZhHtml:
五位朋友坐在电影院一排 \(5\) 个座位中，从左到右编号为 \(1\) 到 \(5\)。（“左”和“右”是从坐在座位上的人的视角看。）

电影期间 Ada 去大厅买爆米花。她回来时发现 Bea 向右移动了两个座位，Ceci 向左移动了一个座位，Dee 和 Edie 交换了座位，并且给 Ada 留下了一个端点座位。Ada 起身前坐在哪个座位？

problems.statementHtml: How many ways are there to write \(2016\) as the sum of twos and threes, ignoring order? (For example, \(1008\cdot 2 + 0\cdot 3\) and \(402\cdot 2 + 404\cdot 3\) are two such ways.)
problems.statementZhHtml: 有多少种方法把 \(2016\) 写成若干个二和若干个三的和，且不考虑顺序？例如，\(1008\cdot 2 + 0\cdot 3\) 和 \(402\cdot 2 + 404\cdot 3\) 是其中两种。

problems.statementHtml: Seven cookies of radius \(1\) inch are cut from a circle of cookie dough, as shown. Neighboring cookies are tangent, and all except the center cookie are tangent to the edge of the dough. The leftover scrap is reshaped to form another cookie of the same thickness. What is the radius in inches of the scrap cookie?
problems.statementZhHtml: 如图，从一块圆形饼干面团中切出七块半径为 \(1\) 英寸的饼干。相邻饼干相切，除中心饼干外，其他饼干都与面团边缘相切。剩下的边角料被重新塑造成另一块同样厚度的饼干。边角料饼干的半径是多少英寸？

problems.statementHtml: A triangle with vertices \(A(0, 2),\) \(B(-3, 2),\) and \(C(-3, 0)\) is reflected about the \(x\)-axis, then the image \(\triangle A'B'C'\) is rotated counterclockwise about the origin by \(90^{\circ}\) to produce \(\triangle A''B''C''.\) Which of the following transformations will return \(\triangle A''B''C''\) to \(\triangle ABC?\)
choices:
counterclockwise rotation about the origin by
\(90^{\circ}\)
clockwise rotation about the origin by \(90^{\circ}\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 顶点为 \(A(0, 2)\)，\(B(-3, 2)\)，和 \(C(-3, 0)\) 的三角形先关于 \(x\) 轴反射，得到的像 \(\triangle A'B'C'\) 再绕原点逆时针旋转 \(90^{\circ}\)，得到 \(\triangle A''B''C''\)。下列哪个变换能把 \(\triangle A''B''C''\) 变回 \(\triangle ABC\)？
choicesZh: 关于直线 \(y = x\) 反射

problems.statementHtml: Let \(N\) be a positive multiple of \(5.\) One red ball and \(N\) green balls are arranged in a line in random order. Let \(P(N)\) be the probability that at least \(\frac{3}{5}\) of the green balls are on the same side of the red ball. Observe that \(P(5)=1\) and that \(P(N)\) approaches \(\frac{4}{5}\) as \(N\) grows large. What is the sum of the digits of the least value of \(N\) such that \(P(N) < \dfrac{321}{400}?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(N\) 是 \(5\) 的正倍数。将一个红球和 \(N\) 个绿球随机排成一行。令 \(P(N)\) 为至少有 \(\frac{3}{5}\) 的绿球在红球同一侧的概率。注意 \(P(5)=1\)，且当 \(N\) 变大时 \(P(N)\) 趋近于 \(\frac{4}{5}\)。使 \(P(N) < \dfrac{321}{400}\) 的最小 \(N\) 的各位数字之和是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Each vertex of a cube is to be labeled with an integer \(1\) through \(8,\) with each integer being used once, in such a way that the sum of the four numbers on the vertices of a face is the same for each face. Arrangements that can be obtained from each other through rotations of the cube are considered to be the same. How many different arrangements are possible?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个立方体的每个顶点要标上从 \(1\) 到 \(8\) 的一个整数，每个整数用一次，使得每个面的四个顶点上的数之和都相同。通过立方体旋转可以互相得到的标法视为相同。有多少种不同标法？

problems.statementHtml:
In rectangle \(ABCD,\) \(AB=6\) and \(BC=3.\) Point \(E\) between \(B\) and \(C,\) and point \(F\) between \(E\) and \(C\) are such that \(BE=EF=FC.\) Segments \(\overline{AE}\) and \(\overline{AF}\) intersect \(\overline{BD}\) at \(P\) and \(Q,\) respectively.

The ratio \(BP:PQ:QD\) can be written as \(r:s:t\) where the greatest common factor of \(r,\) \(s,\) and \(t\) is \(1.\) What is \(r+s+t?\)
problems.statementZhHtml:
在长方形 \(ABCD\) 中，\(AB=6\)，\(BC=3\)。点 \(E\) 在 \(B\) 与 \(C\) 之间，点 \(F\) 在 \(E\) 与 \(C\) 之间，且 \(BE=EF=FC\)。线段 \(\overline{AE}\) 和 \(\overline{AF}\) 分别与 \(\overline{BD}\) 相交于 \(P\) 和 \(Q\)。

比值 \(BP:PQ:QD\) 可写成 \(r:s:t\)，其中 \(r\)，\(s\) 和 \(t\) 的最大公因数为 \(1\)。求 \(r+s+t\)。

problems.statementHtml: For some particular value of \(N,\) when \((a+b+c+d+1)^N\) is expanded and like terms are combined, the resulting expression contains exactly \(1001\) terms that include all four variables \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c,\) and \(d,\) each to some positive power. What is \(N?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 对某个特定的 \(N\)，展开 \((a+b+c+d+1)^N\) 并合并同类项后，所得表达式中恰好有 \(1001\) 项同时包含四个变量 \(a\)、\(b\)、\(c\) 和 \(d\)，且每个变量的指数都为正。求 \(N\)。

problems.statementHtml: Circles with centers \(P,\) \(Q\) and \(R,\) having radii \(1,\) \(2\) and \(3,\) respectively, lie on the same side of line \(l\) and are tangent to \(l\) at \(P',\) \(Q'\) and \(R',\) respectively, with \(Q'\) between \(P'\) and \(R'.\) The circle with center \(Q\) is externally tangent to each of the other two circles. What is the area of \(\triangle PQR?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 圆心为 \(P\)，\(Q\) 和 \(R\)、半径分别为 \(1\)，\(2\) 和 \(3\) 的三个圆位于直线 \(l\) 的同侧，并分别在 \(P'\)，\(Q'\) 和 \(R'\) 处与 \(l\) 相切，其中 \(Q'\) 在 \(P'\) 和 \(R'\) 之间。圆心为 \(Q\) 的圆与另外两个圆都外切。求 \(\triangle PQR\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: For some positive integer \(n,\) the number \(110n^3\) has \(110\) positive integer divisors, including \(1\) and the number \(110n^3.\) How many positive integer divisors does the number \(81n^4\) have?
problems.statementZhHtml: 对某个正整数 \(n\)，数 \(110n^3\) 有 \(110\) 个正整数因数，包括 \(1\) 和 \(110n^3\) 本身。数 \(81n^4\) 有多少个正整数因数？

problems.statementHtml: A binary operation \(\diamondsuit\) has the properties that \[a\,\diamondsuit\, (b\,\diamondsuit \,c) = (a\,\diamondsuit \,b)\cdot c\] and that \(a\,\diamondsuit \,a=1\) for all nonzero real numbers \(a,\) \(b,\) and \(c.\) (Here the dot \(\cdot\) represents the usual multiplication operation.) The solution to the equation \[2016 \,\diamondsuit\, (6\,\diamondsuit\, x)=100\] can be written as \(\frac{p}{q},\) where \(p\) and \(q\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(p+q?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 二元运算 \(\diamondsuit\) 满足 \[a\,\diamondsuit\, (b\,\diamondsuit \,c) = (a\,\diamondsuit \,b)\cdot c\] 以及 \(a\,\diamondsuit \,a=1\)，对所有非零实数 \(a\)，\(b\) 和 \(c\) 都成立。（这里的点号 \(\cdot\) 表示通常的乘法运算。）方程 \[2016 \,\diamondsuit\, (6\,\diamondsuit\, x)=100\] 的解可写成 \(\frac{p}{q}\)，其中 \(p\) 和 \(q\) 为互质正整数。求 \(p+q\) 的值。

problems.statementHtml: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle of radius \(200\sqrt{2}.\) Three of the sides of this quadrilateral have length \(200.\) What is the length of the fourth side?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个四边形内接于半径为 \(200\sqrt{2}\) 的圆。该四边形的三条边长为 \(200\)。第四条边长是多少？

problems.statementHtml: How many ordered triples \((x,y,z)\) of positive integers satisfy \[\text{lcm}(x,y) = 72,\]\[ \text{lcm}(x,z) = 600,\] and \[\text{lcm}(y,z)=900?\]
problems.statementZhHtml: 有多少个正整数有序三元组 \((x,y,z)\) 同时满足 \[\text{lcm}(x,y) = 72\text{，}\] \[ \text{lcm}(x,z) = 600\text{，}\] 以及 \[\text{lcm}(y,z)=900\text{？}\]
